verses.text: Before God’s prophet Moses died, he asked God to bless the Israeli people.
This is what he said:
Yahweh truly loves his people,
I gave them laws to obey,
So Yahweh became the king of his Israeli people
I say this about the tribe of Reuben:
“say this about the tribe of Judah:
I say this about the tribe of Levi:
The tribe of Levi did what you told them to do
The tribe of Levi will teach the Israeli people [DOU] your rules and regulations,
Yahweh, bless their work
I say this about the tribe of Benjamin:
“say this about the tribes of Joseph:
by giving them good fruit ripened by the sun
I desire/hope that very nice fruit will grow on trees in their ancient mountains/hills [DOU],
and that their land will be have many good crops,
The descendants of Joseph will be as strong as [SIM] a bull;
“say this about the tribes of Zebulun and Issachar:
They will invite people from the other Israeli tribes to the mountain where they worship Yahweh,
“say this about the tribe of Gad:
They chose the best part of the land for themselves;
“say this about the tribe of Dan:
“say this about the tribe of Naphtali:
“say this about the tribe of Asher:
Their towns will be protected by high walls with gates that have bronze and iron bars;
“You people of Israel, there is no god like your God,
God, who lives forever, is the one who ◄gives you refuge/protects you►;
So, you Israeli people will live safely;
You people of Israel, Yahweh ◄has blessed/is pleased with► you.
